evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs on pull_request (and workflow_dispatch). It runs `npm ci`, `npm test` and `npm run build` in site/; all three scripts exist in app/site/package.json, and build includes svelte-check. Permissions are least privilege: top-level `contents: read` in ci and pages; only the pages deploy job gets `pages: write`/`id-token: write`; release gets `contents: write`, which `gh release create` needs. The only token used is `github.token`. There is no pull_request_target and nothing was run, pushed or published. However, every action is referenced by a mutable tag, not a full commit SHA: `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-node@v4`, `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3`, `actions/deploy-pages@v4` (step1.patch lines 53-54, 93-94, 105, 121, 146-147). pages.yml also has `workflow_dispatch` with no `if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` guard, so the workflow itself does not restrict deployment to main. release.yml's comment says the tag must point at a commit on main, but nothing checks it.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch 308-382) covers requirements (Node 22), install (`cd site && npm ci`), develop (`npm run dev`), test (`npm test`), build and preview, the other scripts (index, fieldsets, prepare-data, sample-bullets), PAGES_BASE (which vite.config.ts:11 does read), data contribution (with a link to the CONTRIBUTING.md data section: paths, sources, the sample_* rule) and the license (MIT, THIRD-PARTY.md). Every command shown exists in app/site/package.json. The referenced paths (fixtures/, data/bullets/README.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE) exist.
evidence.s1_release: The strategy is consistent. The version lives in site/package.json (0.1.0). A release is a `vX.Y.Z` tag that triggers release.yml, which checks the tag against package.json, extracts the CHANGELOG section as release notes, tests, builds and attaches a zip. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 and SemVer, with explicit rules. CONTRIBUTING gives SemVer rules for data and site and step-by-step release instructions. Dependabot covers npm in /site and GitHub Actions. The convention is Conventional Commits with a type table and a 72-character summary limit. Flaws: (1) the commit `eef1573 docs: add contributor README and CONTRIBUTING with the commit and release conventions` has a 79-character summary, breaking the stated limit; (2) CONTRIBUTING assigns dependencies to `build`, but dependabot.yml uses prefix `chore` for npm; (3) `3e6c393 build: update npm packages and actions with Dependabot` only adds config and uses `build` for a .github change, where the table says `ci`.
evidence.s2_requirements: Route: router.ts:34-42 parses `#/compare/<a>/<b>` and falls back for malformed input; href.compare encodes keys the same way as href.cartridge; it is a hash route, so it survives a reload. Drawing: compare.ts uses caseOuterProfile(adaptMetallic(..)) for both records with one viewportFor([pa,pb], landscape), so both share one scale and axis, and the head face (z=0) of each maps to the same x. There is one `<path>` per outline, and the svg has role=img with aria-label `Profiles of {a} and {b}` taken from record names. Table: caption `Dimensions (mm|in)`; headers Symbol, A name, B name, Difference; symbols come from FIELD_LABELS; only cartridge-part numbers without a FIELD_UNITS entry are included; Tol fields are excluded via orderedFields; Difference is B−A. Units: unitSystem() feeds formatValue for metric and displayNumber(.., 'in') for imperial. Cartridge.svelte:361-368 adds a `Compare with` Label + NativeSelect listing the other cartridges by name and a `Compare` button that sets href.compare(key, chosen). German strings were added. Shot cartridges are excluded from the select and rejected on the route. Changelog entry added and the work committed.
evidence.s2_correctness: I checked against data/cartridges/rimless/308_win.json and belted/300_win_mag.json. eMin 1.4 vs 0.94 gives difference -0.46, and L3 51.18 vs 66.55 gives 15.37 with no float noise thanks to displayNumber's toPrecision(12). Imperial values and differences are converted from millimetres to inches. Angles (alpha, delta, beta), pressures, energies and M are excluded by FIELD_UNITS; L1Tol/P2Tol/ETol are excluded by orderedFields. The overlay is correct: viewportFor takes zMin over both profiles (both start at z=0), and xy() places r about a shared rMax, so the head faces and axes coincide. fullSectionPath gives one closed outline per case. Edge cases: shot cartridges throw and show an alert; undrawable records give null from compareDrawing and a message while the table remains; unknown keys reject in load() and show the error.
evidence.s2_fit: It reuses @lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile), @lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath, fmt), @lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, formatValue), site units.ts/units.svelte.ts, PageHeader, NativeSelect, Label, ShadcnButton, i18n t() with vars, and the lazy-chunk pattern in App.svelte. The footprint is small: router, metadata, nav and one new lib/route pair. Minor issues: compare.ts:19-20 re-implements the group ordering that site/src/lib/fields.ts `orderedGroups` already provides (and does not sort unknown groups); the `r as unknown as CartridgeRecord` double cast; router.ts's header comment ('Five views ... are the whole surface') was not updated.
evidence.s2_tests: site/src/lib/compare.test.ts follows the repo's Vitest setup (inside the include glob, uses @lib/testing/fixtures CARTRIDGES, real records). It covers symbol labels, uniqueness, exclusion of Tol, angles and non-mm fields, B−A without float noise, imperial conversion, two paths in one viewport, head faces at the same x, a shared axis, and null for undrawable records. router.test.ts covers parse/href round trips, encoding and malformed inputs. Not covered: the Compare.svelte accessible names and captions, the Cartridge select/button, shot-cartridge rejection, and imperial row values beyond L3. There is no component-test library in package.json, so the lib-level focus matches the repo.
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: compare.ts compareRows now builds the union of both symbol maps; a missing side yields '' and an empty Difference (step3.patch 41-57). The test was updated to assert `delta L` (A only: b '', difference '') and `R3` (B only: a '', difference ''). The CHANGELOG entry was reworded and the work committed as `fix: ...`. Style: the step 2 Compare.svelte already had `text-right` on the three header cells and the `num text-right` cells, and the utility is generated (shadcn.css `@source "./"`; .text-right appears in the built CSS). No change was needed, and none was made. Weakness: B-only symbols are appended after all of A's rows (R3 ends up after Fe/delta L instead of in the case-head group), so the table order no longer matches the detail page for those rows. No unrelated changes.
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 added an `### Added` entry under `[Unreleased]` and step 3 amended it. Both are consistent with the stated strategy, which bumps site/package.json only when a release is made (CONTRIBUTING 'Making a release'), so leaving version 0.1.0 is correct. The commits `feat: compare two cartridges at #/compare/<a>/<b>` and `fix: list dimensions that only one cartridge publishes in the compare table` follow Conventional Commits within 72 characters. The new code type-checks under the repo tsconfig (ES2022 target for Object.hasOwn; `de` is typed `Record<keyof typeof en, string>` and the keys are complete), and the tests match the data, so CI's npm test and build would plausibly pass.

unmet_requirements: Step 1 workflows reference GitHub Actions by mutable version tags (@v4/@v3), not full commit SHAs
Step 1 commit `eef1573` breaks the stated 72-character summary rule; Dependabot's npm commit prefix (`chore`) contradicts the stated convention (`build` for dependencies)
strengths: The compare feature meets every step 2 requirement and is correct for the data: it reuses caseOuterProfile/viewportFor/fullSectionPath for a true one-scale overlay with aligned head faces, and FIELD_LABELS/FIELD_UNITS/orderedFields/formatValue/displayNumber for the table and units

The release process is coherent and enforced: version in site/package.json, a tag-triggered workflow that checks the tag against package.json and the CHANGELOG section, Keep a Changelog with explicit rules, and an accurate README whose commands all exist
The step 3 bug fix is minimal and precise, with updated tests for A-only and B-only rows and a changelog update; the alignment point was already met, so it was rightly left alone
issues: None of the workflow actions are pinned to full commit SHAs (actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, upload-pages-artifact@v3, deploy-pages@v4), and pages.yml's workflow_dispatch has no main-only guard

Convention inconsistencies from step 1: a 79-character commit summary breaks its own 72-character limit, Dependabot's npm prefix `chore` contradicts the `build`-for-dependencies rule, and the Dependabot config commit is typed `build` instead of `ci`

Minor fit and test gaps: the group-ordering logic duplicates site/src/lib/fields.ts orderedGroups; B-only rows are appended out of the detail-page order after step 3; there are no tests for the Cartridge `Compare with` control or the Compare view's accessible names
review.verdict: The compare view and the step 3 fix are correct, small and well integrated with the repository's libraries and conventions, and the release and documentation setup is coherent. Before merging, the workflows must pin their actions to commit SHAs, and the small mismatches in the commit convention should be fixed.
